scientific_integrity: Proof based on published normalization and projective-group facts plus an explicit geometric Picard-gluing and group-coinduction argument; finite checks are only samples. Historical priority requires independent literature assessment.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns Pic^0 of the singular Ballico–Hefez plane curve and its projective automorphism group, not a cyclic covering surface, a Néron model, or G-linearized bundles. The norm-one factor and Frobenius point count follow from known nodal geometry; the added assertion is the exact equivariant integral character lattice, its mu_2 fixed subgroup scheme and q=5 Specht splitting.
title: Equivariant Picard tori of Ballico–Hefez curves and the ten-node sextic
